select count(1) from corgi_user_follow where user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = '0'

select count(1) from corgi_user_follow f1 join corgi_user_follow f2 on f2.follow_user_id = f1.user_id and f2.user_id = f1.follow_user_id where f1.user_id = #{userId} and f1.is_deleted = '0' and f2.is_deleted = '0'
select count(1) from corgi_user_follow where follow_user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = '0'
select count(1) from corgi_user_follow where follow_user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = '0'

select f.follow_user_id userId, if(p.lat is null,b.lat,p.lat) lat, if(p.lng is null,b.lng,p.lng) lng, p.uptime `time`, if(d.nickname is null,b.bar_name,d.nickname) `nickname`, if(d.avatar is null,b.logo,d.avatar) avatar, if(b.logo is null, d.avatar_check_status, 'normal') avatarCheckStatus, d.role role, d.group `group`, d.con con, f.uptime followTime from corgi_user_follow f left join corgi_user_position p on f.follow_user_id = p.user_id left join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = p.user_id left join corgi_bar_detail b on b.bar_id = f.follow_user_id where f.user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = '0'
order by f.id desc
order by p.uptime desc
order by if(if(p.lat is null,b.lat,p.lat) < 200 and if(p.lng is null,b.lng,p.lng) < 200,st_distance_sphere(point(#{lng},#{lat}),if(p.pt is null,point(b.lng,b.lat) ,p.pt))/100000,100000)
order by f.ctime desc
limit #{start},#{size}

select f.follow_user_id userId, p.lat lat, p.lng lng, p.uptime `time`, d.nickname `nickname`, d.avatar avatar, d.avatar_check_status avatarCheckStatus, d.role role, d.group `group`, if(f.uptime > f1.uptime,f.uptime,f1.uptime) followTime, d.con con from corgi_user_follow f left join corgi_user_position p on f.follow_user_id = p.user_id left join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = p.user_id join corgi_user_follow f1 on f1.follow_user_id = f.user_id and f1.user_id = f.follow_user_id where f.user_id = #{userId} and f.is_deleted = '0' and f1.is_deleted = '0'
order by f.id desc
order by p.uptime desc
order by if(p.lat < 200 and p.lng < 200,st_distance_sphere(point(#{lng},#{lat}),p.pt)/10000,10000)
limit #{start},#{size}

select f.user_id userId, p.lat lat, p.lng lng, p.uptime `time`, d.nickname `nickname`, d.avatar avatar, d.avatar_check_status avatarCheckStatus, d.role role, d.group `group`, d.con con, f.uptime followTime, f.type checkDesc from corgi_user_follow f left join corgi_user_position p on f.user_id = p.user_id left join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = p.user_id where f.follow_user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = '0' order by f.uptime desc limit #{start}, #{size}

select d.nickname `nickname`, d.avatar avatar, d.avatar_status avatarStatus, d.role role, d.group `group`, d.height `height`, d.weight `weight`, d.con con, d.birthday birthday, d.check_status checkStatus, d.avatar_check_status avatarCheckStatus, p.user_id userId, p.lat lat, p.lng lng, p.uptime `time`, f.uptime followTime, f.is_read isRead from corgi_user_follow f left join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = f.user_id left join corgi_user_position p on f.user_id = p.user_id where f.follow_user_id = #{userId} order by f.uptime desc limit #{start}, #{size}
select f.user_id userId, f.ctime createTime from corgi_user_follow f where f.type = 'real' and f.is_deleted = '0' order by f.id desc limit #{start}, #{size}
